overview.description: The WisdomTree Interest Rate Hedged U.S. Aggregate Bond Fund (AGZD) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund tracks a long/short net-zero-duration bond index that's long US investment-grade issues and short Treasury futures. AGZD was launched on Dec 18, 2013 and is issued by WisdomTree.
